whatToExpect: Arrive 15 minutes before your appointment time
Bring your completed forms and your insurance cards
Bring a list of any medications you are currently taking
Expect that your eyes may be dilated during your visit
If your insurance requires a referral from your primary care physician, bring it with you

goodToKnow.name: Bringing someone with you
goodToKnow.body: You are welcome to bring a friend or family member. An extra set of ears helps you remember everything your doctor goes over with you.

goodToKnow.name: When to make an appointment
goodToKnow.body: Schedule a visit if you have eye discomfort or trouble with your vision. Health conditions such as high blood pressure or diabetes also raise your risk for certain eye diseases.

goodToKnow.name: How often to come in
goodToKnow.body: If you have a history of eye disease, keep regular appointments and follow up as your ophthalmologist advises.

goodToKnow.name: Protecting your eyes
goodToKnow.body: Wear protective eyewear for yard work, construction and sports. If you wear contacts, wash your hands before handling them and replace them as directed to prevent infections.
